The four realtool fixture files are deterministic synthetic data and PAR2
packets generated by par2cmdline (par2 create -s1024 -c4 -n1) over fileA.bin
(8000 bytes) and fileB.bin (5600 bytes). They provide interoperability coverage
independent of Tessarr's parser and finite-field implementation.

Source: kipsilabs/altmount, commit 9260b9f97dfe340e38911d15d04c234b2675be73,
internal/importer/parser/par2/testdata/realtool. Used under the accompanying
MIT license. No runtime code from AltMount is included.
